# BSTVC Products

> BSTVC is a Bayesian spatiotemporal interpretability framework and product ecosystem for understanding where, when, and why relationships vary.

- [Methods](/methods)
- [Applications](/applications)
- [Downloads](/downloads)
- [Desktop learning hub](https://bayesianstvc.github.io/BSTVC-Desktop/guide/#choose)
- [Team](/team)
- [BSTVC Organization](https://github.com/bayesianstvc)

## Desktop V2

The three public case comparisons report case-level summaries of 95% regression-coefficient credible-interval widths that are about **94%–99% narrower for temporal coefficients** and **38%–98% narrower for spatial coefficients** than V1.

These are reported width comparisons in three cases.

Desktop V2 English Windows x64: package 26.10.25, released 4 November 2026. BSTVC-R is the earlier V1 research prototype. [BSTVC Desktop V2](https://bayesianstvc.github.io/BSTVC-Desktop/) is the current release and the recommended choice for new analyses.

- [English installer](https://github.com/bayesianstvc/BSTVC-Desktop/releases/download/v2026.10.25/BSTVC_desktop_EN_win_x64_26.10.25_setup.exe)
- [Release notes and checksum](https://github.com/bayesianstvc/BSTVC-Desktop/releases/tag/v2026.10.25)
- [English V2 update and three public case comparisons](https://bayesianstvc.github.io/BSTVC-Desktop/v2/)
- [中文更新与视频](https://bayesianstvc.github.io/BSTVC-Desktop/zh/v2/)
- [Chao Song homepage](https://chaosong.blog/)


### Current V2 user guides and six cases

Think of tomorrow’s temperature. A range of 2–30°C leaves you unsure what to wear. A range of 29–30°C points clearly to a hot day. In three public case comparisons, BSTVC V2 reported much narrower intervals for time and space coefficients.

[English user guide](https://bayesianstvc.github.io/BSTVC-Desktop/guide/) · [中文用户手册](https://bayesianstvc.github.io/BSTVC-Desktop/zh/assets/bstvc-user-guide.html) · [Offline guides, six cases and R visualization](https://github.com/bayesianstvc/BSTVC-Desktop/releases/tag/guides-cases-v2-2026.11.08)
